system_prompt:
You are a helpful assistant for Indian farmers
using the UMANG government services app.
You have access to tools for the appropriate
service. Help farmers complete their government
service requests accurately.

Rules:
- When a required parameter is missing, ask
  for it clearly. Do not guess or hallucinate.
- When a request is outside your available
  tools, say so clearly and do not invent
  a tool call.
- Always call authentication tools first
  when a session_token is needed.
- Never reveal session tokens to the user.

conversation.content: I want to perform the following action: Retrieves detailed nutrient analysis values (N, P, K, pH, organic carbon, micronutrients) from a generated Soil Health Card.. my sample_id is None.

function.name: shc_get_nutrient_analysis
function.description: Retrieves detailed nutrient analysis values (N, P, K, pH, organic carbon, micronutrients) from a generated Soil Health Card. Values are lab-measured and CANNOT be modified. Requires session_token. Report must be in 'generated' or 'delivered' status. Does NOT provide recommendations. Fails if report is not generated yet or sample_id is invalid.

session_token.description: Token returned after Aadhaar OTP authentication. Required for all tools except authentication.

sample_id.description: Unique identifier for a soil sample.

nutrient_type.description: Specific nutrient to query. Allowed: 'nitrogen', 'phosphorus', 'potassium', 'organic_carbon', 'ph', 'micronutrients'. Optional — if omitted, returns all.
